script.code:
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR) AS based_uom,
       i.stock_control,
       i.show_delivery,
       i.serial_number_management,
       i.material_costing_method,
       i.net_weight,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
                      'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                      'base_qty', u.base_qty))
           FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
           WHERE u.Item_id = i.id
             AND u.is_deleted = 0
       ), '[]') AS uom_conversion_json,
       COALESCE(pk.packing_detail_json, '[]') AS packing_detail_json
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_gate.data.materialIdCsv}}', ']'),
                '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
JOIN item i
  ON i.id = sel.mid
 AND i.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT p.Item_id AS iid,
           JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
               'uom_id', CAST(p.uom_id AS CHAR),
               'packing_uom_id', CAST(p.packing_uom_id AS CHAR),
               'quantity', p.quantity)) AS packing_detail_json
    FROM item_vabbbwt2_sub p
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_gate.data.materialIdCsv}}', ']'),
                    '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel2
      ON sel2.mid = p.Item_id
    WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
    GROUP BY p.Item_id
) pk ON pk.iid = i.id

script.code:
SELECT 'SETUP' AS kind, CAST(ps.id AS CHAR) AS id, COALESCE(CAST(ps.picking_mode AS CHAR), '') AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM (SELECT p.id, p.picking_mode
          FROM picking_setup p
         WHERE p.organization_id = '{{node:code_v2ids.data.orgSql}}'
           AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id
         LIMIT 1) ps
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITEM' AS kind, CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.stock_control AS CHAR), '') AS f1,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.material_costing_method AS CHAR), '') AS f2,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.item_batch_management AS CHAR), '') AS f3,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.serial_number_management AS CHAR), '') AS f4,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR), '') AS f5
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.organization_id = '{{node:code_v2ids.data.orgSql}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN ({{node:code_gate.data.materialIdCsv}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HU' AS kind, CAST(hi.material_id AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM handling_unit h
  JOIN handling_unit_atu7sreg_sub hi
    ON hi.handling_unit_id = h.id
   AND hi.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.organization_id = '{{node:code_v2ids.data.orgSql}}'
   AND h.plant_id = {{node:code_v2ids.data.plantSql}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
   AND (h.packing_id IS NULL OR h.packing_id = '')
   AND hi.material_id IN ({{node:code_gate.data.materialIdCsv}})
 GROUP BY hi.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PEND' AS kind, CAST(r.parent_line_id AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.organization_id = '{{node:code_v2ids.data.orgSql}}'
   AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_v2ids.data.plantSql}}
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
   AND r.status = 'Pending'
   AND r.parent_line_id IN ({{node:code_v2ids.data.soLineIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY r.parent_line_id
